decisions.reason: After several years with no visible web presence, this conferencing offer looks peripheral to the firm's infrastructure-led strategy and easier to abandon despite the initial launch investment.

The metropolitan data centre connection network remains tightly aligned with the firm's owned fibre, cloud and low-latency strengths, and the earlier adoption plus prior commitment make continued backing more likely than withdrawal.

Although its visibility has faded and voice is less central than data and cloud, the ordering portal still fits the firm's automation and real-time provisioning agenda, so sunk development effort and strategic fit favor retention for now.
